title: mail: E2E integration test (full JMAP session)
description:
Write a Rust integration test in crates/mail/tests/jmap_e2e.rs: start the mail server in-process on a random port (tokio::spawn), authenticate to get a session, call Mailbox/get (assert comp.test mailbox present), call Email/query for comp.test (assert at least 1 result), call Email/get by returned id (assert subject matches), call Blob/get by blobId (assert non-empty bytes). Seed data: POST one article via usenet-ipfs-reader in-process before starting the mail server.

Why: the integration test is the primary verification that all layers work end-to-end; unit tests of individual methods are insufficient to catch wiring bugs.

Acceptance: test passes in cargo test --workspace.
